models_evaluated: computer-aided detection (CADe) devices for colonoscopy (vendor not specified)

links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate change after CADe deployment versus control facilities in randomized design
links.effect: ADR rose 4.2 percentage points (50.7% to 54.9%) at CADe sites and fell 0.7 points (51.8% to 51.1%) at controls; adjusted OR 1.22 (95% CI 1.15-1.28).
links.quote: Using multivariable regression, CADe availability was associated with a significantly increased odds of adenoma detection (odds ratio, 1.22; 95% CI, 1.15 to 1.28), but was not associated with detection of other lesions or changes in withdrawal time.

screen.reason: Pragmatic cluster randomized study evaluating the clinical effectiveness of deploying CADe (computer-aided detection) AI devices for colonoscopy on adenoma detection rates in real clinical practice compared to usual care.
